title: 露店用パラソル
description: 朝市や露店の売り場に立てる、8枚張りの布製パラソルです。御影石の台座と差し込み口、木の柱、生成りとテラコッタ色の交互の布、骨と受け骨、ろくろ、頭の飾り、縁の垂れ幕を造形しています。布は無地で、開閉や風での揺れは動作せず、売り物や看板の文字は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.500 × 2.400 × 2.500 m、3,780三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An eight-panel canvas parasol for morning markets and street stalls. It models the granite base with socket, a wooden pole, alternating cream and terracotta canvas panels, ribs and stretchers, runner, finial and a valance around the edge. The canvas is plain; opening, closing and wind motion are not rigged, and goods or sign lettering are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.500 × 2.400 × 2.500 m; 3,780 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
